compute_grad_norm_simplex: compute the norm of a gradient projected onto the tangent space of a probability simplex
project_gradient_simplex: project a gradient vector onto the tangent space of the probability simplex
project_vector_simplex: project a vector onto the probability simplex using efficient O(n log n) Euclidean projection
project_to_simplex_interior: project a distribution onto the interior of the simplex ensuring minimum element bounds
